Train a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with MMD Regularization

Source: R/MMD_Vae.R
trainVAEModel.Rd

Trains a VAE with MMD regularization, where the MMD loss enforces distributional similarity between true and encoded samples in latent space.

Usage

trainVAEModel(
  trainData,
  useMarkers,
  epochs = 80,
  latentDim = NULL,
  seed = 1994,
  lambda = 0.1,
  valData,
  originalDim = 27L,
  batchSize = 16,
  hiddenSizes = NULL,
  verbose = 1L,
  earlyStop = TRUE,
  patience = 15L
)

Arguments

trainData

Data frame of training data.

useMarkers

Character vector; names of marker columns to use.

epochs

Integer; number of training epochs, default is 80.

latentDim

Integer; dimensionality of latent space, optional.

lambda

Numeric; regularization weight for MMD loss, default is 0.1.

valData

Data frame of validation data.

originalDim

Integer; dimensionality of input, default is 27.

batchSize

Integer; batch size for training, default is 16.

verbose

Integer; training output verbosity. 0 = silent, 1 = progress bar, 2 = one line per epoch. Default is 1.

earlyStop

Logical; whether to use early stopping based on validation loss. Default is TRUE.

patience

Integer; number of epochs with no improvement before stopping. Only used when earlyStop = TRUE. Default is 15.

Value

List containing the trained VAE model and encoder.

Examples

# Load sample data
data(sample_cytof_data)
data(sample_markers)

# First compute reference samples for optimal training/validation split
ref_samples <- computeReferenceSample(
  data = sample_cytof_data,
  markers = sample_markers,
  sampleCol = "sample_id",
  N = 2
)

# Use top samples (most representative) for training
train_data <- sample_cytof_data[
  sample_cytof_data$sample_id %in% ref_samples$topNSamples,
  sample_markers
]

# Use bottom samples (most distinct) for validation
val_data <- sample_cytof_data[
  sample_cytof_data$sample_id %in% ref_samples$bottomNSamples,
  sample_markers
]

# Train VAE model with optimal data split
vae_model <- trainVAEModel(
  trainData = train_data,
  useMarkers = sample_markers,
  epochs = 30,
  latentDim = 2,
  hiddenSizes = c(4, 3),
  lambda = 0.01,
  valData = val_data,
  originalDim = length(sample_markers),
  batchSize = 32,
  seed = 1994
)

# Access components
encoder <- vae_model$encoder
vae <- vae_model$vae
